name: This Is Fine
look: Two comic panels. Left: a cartoon dog in a small brown bowler hat sits on a chair at a table with a coffee mug while flames fill the room and smoke covers the ceiling. Right: a close-up of the smiling dog, still surrounded by fire, saying "THIS IS FINE."
use: Shows someone calmly pretending everything is okay while a situation falls apart around them. The flames are labeled as the mounting problem and the dog as the person or group in denial.
slots: the disaster or chaos, placed on the flames or above the comic
the person in denial, placed on the dog
examples: My inbox after one day off
Our team, still picking a font
describe: cartoon dog with a hat sitting in a burning room
dog drinking coffee calmly while the house is on fire
comic dog smiling surrounded by flames pretending all is okay
dog at a table with a mug says it's fine while everything burns
two panel comic of a dog ignoring a fire
origin: The first two panels of On Fire, a 2013 strip from K.C. Green's webcomic Gunshow.
